question:
S is the father of W. D is the only sister of W. R is the mother's mother of D. L, the mother of P, is married to S.

How is P related to W
solution:
[IMAGE: https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf9WrMX2PxUUiuc23xtLzIYfAm-irKB4b57QlaLQLGdZfRiZezLGmE-LDNzE8Cwo2irGS7CWeUw-nY5zMYIdWPZre6UsWnYjv1MpUAVRhIwEu2rYK0rb8Zv1_QSlVCu5fvDClEGTgVIIgUmbHNzoyQcd8-5?key=Pg8w9VmbvKrHmQxFZbtW-g] 

Given:

1) S is the father of W.

2) D is the only sister of W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16382840c4cb7edd19300082eb8cd7ef3bb0c6109dce7a26fb975754cdbb0ae0.png] 

3) R is the mother's mother of D. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0c91d84a5c69dca593b1350252d231f0520b8478e1c62e9a003c27b1afb687a.png] 

4) L, the mother of P, is married to S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8ad6ee307705e9ba982743bd8f141f15134db61d56baf428ce1d7442bcafd07.png] 

Thus, P is W's brother.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
